summary.text: Daniel Alders is a Republican state representative from Texas House District 6 who has represented the district since 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He works in property management and previously served as East Texas regional director for U.S. Sen. Ted Cruz.

paragraphs.text: Daniel Alders was born in Dallas, Texas, and earned a bachelor's degree from New Saint Andrews College in 2009.
His career experience includes working in property management.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he began a real estate career in Nacogdoches, moved to Tyler in 2015 to serve as East Texas Regional Director for Sen. Ted Cruz, and in 2017 joined Drake Real Estate to run its commercial property management company.
He also said he has chaired the Tyler Area Chamber of Commerce's Governmental Affairs Committee and serves as a deacon at Fifth Street Presbyterian Church.
Alders took office on January 14, 2025, succeeding Matt Schaefer.
He advanced from the Republican primary on March 3, 2026, and faces Democrat Lorenzo Johnson in the general election.
